gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each board costs today in its silent-switch trim: the Lofree Flow 2 84 with Void switches is $135.20 at checkout ($169 on the page), the Rainy 75 Pro SHHH is $169.99 and its maker says it "is not completely silent", the Keychron V1 Max is $85.99 but ships with non-silent Gateron Jupiter switches while Keychron's own Silent K Pro set is out of stock, and Kensington's page marks the MK7500F discontinued.
standout_why: Compared against the two cited pages I could read. mkbguide.com (cited in chat 2) lists the NuPhy Air75 V3 Blush Nano, Cherry KC 200 MX, Lofree Flow 2 84 Void and Logitech MX Mechanical but shows no price for any of them, only 'Check price on Amazon', and never mentions the Rainy 75, Kensington or Gamakay. keyboardranker.com (cited in chat 2) has prices dated 2026-11-21, but only for the Logitech MX Mechanical Mini ($129.99), a Keychron V6 Max in CA$ and the HHKB; it gives no price for the Kensington (Canadian listing 'Coming Soon') or the Cherry ('Send Request'), and omits Lofree, NuPhy, Rainy 75 and Gamakay. Neither has the Lofree cart discount, the Wobkey 'not completely silent' wording, or the Keychron silent-switch stock status. The two RTINGS pages (cited in chat 1) returned only navigation to me, so I could not compare against them; the score assumes they carry measured noise and list prices but not the cart price.
decides: Price does not overturn the noise pick, but it reorders ChatGPT's list. Its 'Best premium' Lofree Flow 2 84 Void, which it left unpriced, costs $135.20 at checkout: $34.79 below the Rainy 75 Pro SHHH and inside the $111.96 to $139.95 range of the NuPhy Air75 V3's Amazon listings. So the Lofree is the aluminum, factory-silent, low-profile board we can link at a mid-range price, not a premium outlier. Three of ChatGPT's picks weaken on today's pages: the V1 Max needs a separate silent-switch set (Keychron's own Silent K Pro set is out of stock), the Rainy's maker disclaims silence, and the Kensington shows discontinued on kensington.com. The Gamakay TK75HE V2 with Phoenix V3 silent switches at $79.19 is the under-$100 factory-silent wireless row, a segment ChatGPT filled with a wired Cherry or a board that needs new switches. The NuPhy Air75 V3 Blush Nano stays the board ChatGPT backs with a measured figure; I could not read its maker price today.
